premium.basis: Offer price of $9.00 vs. unaffected last close before announcement ($7.45 on 2016-09-09)

value_inflection_events.event: Negative data from Phase 2b CyNCh study (pediatric NASH); stock dropped 41.7%
Rebound on additional NIDDK data presented at AASLD; stock recovered 27.2%
Negative correction following CyNCh data; stock declined 25.1%
QUINSAIR launch in Europe; stock recovered 20.6%
Momentum from rare disease franchise execution; stock advanced 22.4%
Horizon Pharma acquisition announcement at $9.00 per share + CVR; stock spiked 20.7%

leaked_early.details: Reuters reported in April 2016 that Raptor had held exploratory discussions with investment bankers to evaluate a potential sale; later rumors linked Horizon Pharma as potential acquirer in June 2016.

notes: Cash tender offer with CVRs tied to QUINSAIR FDA approval and $100M sales; CVR conditions were never met. Stock had fallen significantly after NASH trial failure in 2015 before recovering modestly prior to the deal.
